provenance.source_name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index (year pending), Michigan county file
provenance.ranking_universe: United States counties (RPL_* percentile ranks, 0 = least vulnerable, 1 = most)
provenance.pending_reason: Could not fetch or parse the SVI county CSV (No SVI county CSV could be fetched. 2022: [cdc-svi-county-2022] fetch failed: HTTP 403 | 2020: [cdc-svi-county-2020] fetch failed: HTTP 403). Re-run scripts/refresh-cdc-svi-county.mjs --apply on the scheduled dataset-refresh workflow to populate real values.
provenance.notes: The SVI is ATSDR's composite percentile ranking of ACS 5-year inputs, so every value is MODELED: a published model, not a direct count. Theme ranks are US-wide county percentiles (0-1); the EP_* inputs are ATSDR's own ACS-derived percentages and are republished here with the same label. -999 in the source means the value is unavailable and becomes null, never 0. When status = 'pending-ci' the ingest environment could not reach svi.cdc.gov; the scheduled dataset-refresh workflow populates the file.

inputs.label: Persons 25+ with no high school diploma

Occupied units with more people than rooms
